# Hand Coded

> Hand Coded is a Barcelona studio that designs and builds interactive art installations, immersive spaces and real-time software: light, sound, AI and our own tools.

## Founders
- Cyril Laurier: Co-founder. PhD in music AI, Sony CSL researcher.
- Maya Benaïnous: Co-founder. Artist and engineer, creator of Ledotron.

## Work
- [Peupler / Populate](https://mouawadlaurier.com/handcoded/?p=peupler): Maya Mouawad, music by Cyril Laurier · 2022 – 2025 · Venice Biennale, Dakar Biennale, Boulogne. How can every living being, human and non-human, share the same territories? Peupler lets us see and feel the point of view of a tree watching our cities, a witness of the ecological changes it wishes for. A new kind of immersive room made entirely of real-time generative content. It adapts to the…
- [Retour aux Sources](https://mouawadlaurier.com/handcoded/?p=retour-aux-sources): Mouawad Laurier · 2019 · Maison Ruinart, Reims, UNESCO World Heritage. A root planted in a chalk cellar dug more than two thousand years ago, thirty metres underground. In this mineral darkness, it listens to the living world breathing on the surface. The root listens to the natural elements involved in making champagne. In real time it captures climate data,…
- [Rising](https://mouawadlaurier.com/handcoded/?p=rising): Maya Mouawad, music by Cyril Laurier · 2022 – 2025 · Nuit Blanche Paris, Llum Barcelona, MIRA, La Rochelle, Aveiro. An outdoor sound and light installation about our vulnerability. It turns scientific data on rising sea levels into a sensory experience: waves of light rise and flood the space in real time. The system is connected live to oceanographic data from the University of La Rochelle. The stronger the…
- [Éphémère](https://mouawadlaurier.com/handcoded/?p=ephemere): Maya Mouawad, with Art Explora · 2023 · Fondation OVE Paris, Sant Joan de Déu Barcelona, CHU Lille. The present moment as a living artwork. Through their simple presence, visitors create a moving painting and an evolving music. A depth sensor follows every kind of movement, with no instructions and no prerequisites: anyone can play, whatever their motor or communication abilities. Éphémère turns…
- [Tientos al tiempo](https://mouawadlaurier.com/handcoded/?p=tientos): Pablo Valbuena & Patricia Guerrero · 2020 · CENTQUATRE, Paris. A flamenco performance where light becomes a stage object. We built the real-time sound analysis and the performance setup that let the light answer the dancer and the voice. “I want to use the light as an object, not as a way to display the performer.” Pablo Valbuena Produced by the CENTQUATRE in…
- [Maestro](https://mouawadlaurier.com/handcoded/?p=maestro): Mouawad Laurier & Tigre Lab · 2017 · Sharjah Light Festival, UAE. Three interactive experiences projected on a 500-metre-wide monument. Visitors touch a physical model of the building, and their gestures play sound and image on the façade. SAND: move sand particles and compose a desert soundscape. ORGAN: become the DJ of an interactive looper that triggers video…
- [Future Ruins](https://mouawadlaurier.com/handcoded/?p=future-ruins): Romain Tardy · 2015 · La Nuit des Images, Lausanne. A music and light performance on hand-built light structures. The challenge: keep LED animation, video mapping and music perfectly in sync. We helped Romain Tardy choose the technical approach for his custom LED structures, made them controllable over Art-Net, and adapted Ledotron for real-time…
- [S.A.T.](https://mouawadlaurier.com/handcoded/?p=sat): Romain Tardy, an attempt to send a message to outer space · 2017 · SkyDesert Festival, Hebei, China. A large light, sound and visual installation made of 72 networked modules. By day they are mirrors reflecting the sky; at night they light up in patterns visible from far away. Visitors join a local wifi network with their phone. Their IP address appears on the installation, then turns into a light…
- [OX](https://mouawadlaurier.com/handcoded/?p=ox): Romain Tardy & Mouawad Laurier · 2014 – 2016 · Touring, France. The first machine that is sensitive to music: an AI-driven DJ stage made of moving LED structures. Real-time machine learning listens to the DJ and decides what to show, when and how. A semi-generative system that follows the artist’s design while keeping control of the image, and that packs,…
- [MGNTRN](https://mouawadlaurier.com/handcoded/?p=mgntrn): Romain Tardy · 2014 · PROYECTA, Puebla, Mexico. An immersive show built around a Ferris wheel, projection screens and 10-metre LED strips, all synchronised with the music. We wrote the software to previsualise, animate and control every light from a single timeline, and built a robot that turns the Ferris wheel's control knobs in response to…
- [Ledotron](https://mouawadlaurier.com/handcoded/?p=ledotron): Our software to create and run light shows · 2015 – 2026 · From Mexico to China. We wrote Ledotron for our own installations, and it has run more than forty of them since 2015, from OX to Retour aux Sources. LED strips, motorised lights, video walls and the venue itself are drawn in 3D; the show is composed on a timeline, and the result can be seen before a single cable is…
- [Viktoria Modesta](https://mouawadlaurier.com/handcoded/?p=viktoria-modesta): Music Tech Fest performance · 2016 · Music Tech Fest, Berlin. Viktoria Modesta is a singer whose bionic leg is at the heart of her shows. For Music Tech Fest 2016 she challenged a team of hackers: let her control music and lights with her leg and arm movements, her voice and her brain. The show was built in under a week: leg and body sensors, interactive…
- [Beardyman](https://mouawadlaurier.com/handcoded/?p=beardyman): Beardytron · 2015. Beardyman is an improvising beatboxer who samples and twists his own voice into music. We design software that lets him compose live, as fast as he thinks. Our latest module for the Beardytron 5000 mkIII: the Instant Drum Machine.
- [TGIC](https://mouawadlaurier.com/handcoded/?p=tgic): Romain Tardy, The Great Indecision Council · 2018 · Vlieland, Netherlands, then on tour. A large light and sound installation in a 25-metre circle, fed in real time by the terms most searched on Google in the host country. Visitors stand among light, words and computer-generated chants: an involuntary self-portrait of our networked society. Hand Coded wrote the original software.…

Adrien M & Claire B create performances that mix the real and the virtual. Together we explored new interactive elements for their shows, with particles that live with the performers on stage. Do you feel the particles? Creative residency in Cherbourg, 2014.

Light travels through Durham Cathedral, inside and out, following its bells. The work draws on change ringing, the 17th-century art of ringing bells in numerical sequences: the cathedral is divided into ten segments, one per bell, and the light answers the sound. - [Sonaris](https://mouawadlaurier.com/handcoded/?p=sonaris): AI music search engine. A music recommendation engine. Sonaris analyses an audio stream in real time and finds the tracks that sound like it, whatever their name or origin. Discover new artists, build well-mixed playlists, license music for film and advertising in minutes. “I like it: is there anything else like it?”…

Launched for Nestlé México at the Palacio de los Deportes, Mexico City, in October 2015, together with an app and a website.

Five years without touching land, 150,000 km a year, 75 years of life. The albatross is almost impossible to observe: it spends 80% of its life between water and air and only lands to breed on the island where it was born. - [Augmented Paper](https://mouawadlaurier.com/handcoded/?p=augmented-paper): Collective residency with 30 artists · 2015 · Abbaye de Vivoin, France. A collective residency with thirty artists around augmented paper: exploring the borders between physical matter, print and digital interaction. A research on the object as a medium for sensory experience, between the craftsman’s gesture and code.

## Expertise
- [Machine learning & our own AI](https://mouawadlaurier.com/handcoded/?p=machine-learning). Systems that listen, watch and decide: emotion detection in music, real-time choices on stage, recommendation engines.
- [Real-time development](https://mouawadlaurier.com/handcoded/?p=real-time). Software that reacts within the frame: custom engines in C++, openFrameworks, OpenGL and shaders, built to run night after night.
- [Audio processing](https://mouawadlaurier.com/handcoded/?p=audio). Sound analysis and generation that drive light, image and motion: beat detection, spatialisation, interactive music.
- [Generative animation](https://mouawadlaurier.com/handcoded/?p=generative). Algorithms that generate designs and animations, for LEDs, screens and projection.
- [Projection mapping](https://mouawadlaurier.com/handcoded/?p=projection-mapping). Projection on architecture, objects and bodies, synchronised with sound and sensors.
- [Light and LED control](https://mouawadlaurier.com/handcoded/?p=light). From a few strips to thousands of LEDs and motors, designed and driven with Ledotron, over DMX and Art-Net.
- [Tracking and sensors](https://mouawadlaurier.com/handcoded/?p=tracking). Kinect, Leap Motion, cameras, body and brain sensors: we turn people's presence and movement into data.
- [Concept design](https://mouawadlaurier.com/handcoded/?p=concept-design). We join the brainstorm early, suggest the technologies that serve the idea, and carry it from concept to production.
- [Sustainable thinking](https://mouawadlaurier.com/handcoded/?p=sustainable). Sustainable design approaches in the choice of materials, energy and durability of every installation.
- [Project management](https://mouawadlaurier.com/handcoded/?p=project-management). One team from the first sketch to the last show, with artists, agencies and brands.
- [Our tools](https://mouawadlaurier.com/handcoded/?p=tools). Autodesk Maya, After Effects, TouchDesigner, Photoshop, Xcode, MadMapper, Millumin, Ableton Live and our own Ledotron. C++, OpenGL, openFrameworks, Objective-C, SceneKit, Python, Max/MSP, GLSL, VST and WebGL.
- [Hardware and protocols](https://mouawadlaurier.com/handcoded/?p=hardware). DMX, Art-Net, OSC, Kinect 1 and 2, Leap Motion, augmented reality, iOS, Android and Arduino.
- [Immersive](https://mouawadlaurier.com/handcoded/?p=nouveau-contenu): Rooms of light, sound and data that answer the people inside them.. We design and build immersive spaces where image, light and sound are generated in real time, so the work is never the same twice. Cameras and sensors follow the visitors, live data from the climate, the music or the place feeds the content, and the room becomes a living environment rather than a…

## Studio
- [Cyril Laurier](https://mouawadlaurier.com/handcoded/?p=cyril): Co-founder. PhD in music AI, Sony CSL researcher. · Barcelona. His PhD at the Music Technology Group of the Universitat Pompeu Fabra used machine learning to detect emotions in music. Before that, he studied acoustics, signal processing and computer science applied to music at IRCAM (ATIAM master), where he wrote a generative algorithm for automatic music…
- [Maya Benaïnous](https://mouawadlaurier.com/handcoded/?p=maya): Co-founder. Artist and engineer, creator of Ledotron. · Barcelona. Artist and engineer, she creates immersive installations at the crossroads of ecology, technology and the senses, and has worked with real-time data since 2008. She invented a new way to work with LEDs: Ledotron. Trained in mathematics, biology and art and technology (IMAC engineering school), she…
- [Stéphanie Huerre](https://mouawadlaurier.com/handcoded/?p=stephanie): Maths, art and new technologies, sustainable design.. Ten years at Walt Disney Imagineering R&D, where she led a 3D AI simulation tool to study crowd flow and visitor experience in theme parks, and brought sustainable design into the process. She likes riding her bike.
- [Romain Tardy](https://mouawadlaurier.com/handcoded/?p=romain-tardy): Visual artist. OX, S.A.T., MGNTRN, Future Ruins, TGIC. Hand Coded designed and developed his creation and control tools from 2014 to 2021.
- [Pablo Valbuena](https://mouawadlaurier.com/handcoded/?p=pablo-valbuena): Visual artist. Kinematope, Gyrotope, Wave, Methods, Tientos al tiempo. Hand Coded designed and developed his creation and control tools from 2014 to 2020.
- [Adrien M & Claire B](https://mouawadlaurier.com/handcoded/?p=adrien-m-claire-b): Digital arts and performance company. Mouvement de l’air, world tour.
- [Beardyman](https://mouawadlaurier.com/handcoded/?p=beardyman-musician): Musician
- [Maotik](https://mouawadlaurier.com/handcoded/?p=maotik): Visual artist. EKO, with Ezra, MIRA Festival 2014.
- [Ezra](https://mouawadlaurier.com/handcoded/?p=ezra): Beatboxer, Organic Orchestra. Bionic Orchestra and EKO, with the Organic Orchestra company, from 2008.
- [Pedra](https://mouawadlaurier.com/handcoded/?p=pedra): Artist and costume designer
